Q1: Which branch should the fix land on?
Choices:
A) PR #6643's head branch `ai/issue-6641` (as `Integration branch: ai/issue-6641`). Make `.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py` identical to that branch's template, keeping the fresh `query_pull_requests` lookup for remote writes. (RECOMMENDED)
B) The default branch `main`. The template there has no fresh-lookup change yet, so the sync would do nothing or would carry an unmerged change ahead of PR #6643.
C) Don't open a separate fix. Close this triage issue and let PR #6643's own review/autofix (or the review-blocked judge) add the live-hook edit on `ai/issue-6641`.
